privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
body: When you use Oiyo Blog, we may collect the following types of information:
We do not collect names, passwords, or payment information, and reading the site does not require an account.
list: Usage data — pages visited, time on page, browser type, device type, and referring URL, collected automatically through Google Analytics 4.
Cookies — set for analytics (Google Analytics) and advertising (Google AdSense). See sections 3–5.
Contact information — if you email us at support@oiyo.net, we receive your email address and the contents of your message.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
body: We do not sell your personal information.
list: To measure traffic and improve the site's content and performance.
To show advertising through Google AdSense.
To respond to messages you send us.
To meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: 3. Google Analytics
body: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how visitors use the site. It collects usage data in aggregate and does not tell us who you are. You can opt out across all sites with the browser add-on below.

sections.heading: 4. Google AdSense and Advertising
body: We use Google AdSense to display ads. Google and its partners use cookies and similar technologies to serve and measure ads, including ads based on your prior visits to this and other sites. You can turn off personalized advertising in your Google account or through the industry opt-out page below. Turning off personalization does not remove ads; it makes them less specific to you.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
body: We use two kinds of cookies:
You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some parts of the site may not work correctly without them.
list: Analytics cookies — set by Google Analytics to measure site usage.
Advertising cookies — set by Google AdSense to serve and measure ads.

sections.heading: 6. Third-Party Services
body: The site links to services run by other companies. We do not control those services and are not responsible for how they handle your data. Review their own privacy policies before using them.

sections.heading: 7. Data Retention
body: Analytics data is kept according to Google's retention settings (14 months by default). Messages you send us are kept only as long as needed to answer them.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:
To make a request, email us at support@oiyo.net.
list: see the data we hold about you;
ask us to delete it;
opt out of analytics tracking;
withdraw your consent to cookies.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Privacy
body: Oiyo Blog is not directed at children under 14, and we do not knowingly collect information from them. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the latest change is shown at the top of the page. If you keep using the site after a change, that means you accept the updated policy.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Email us at support@oiyo.net.

about.headline: Engineering a clearer future.
about.description: Oiyo Blog is a knowledge academy that unpacks psychology, fortune, money, science, and everyday life with well-sourced material — a place to understand your test results, build practical skills, and see the world one layer deeper.
about.philosophyText: We value evidence over verdicts. Psychology content names its academic scales and limits, money and tax guides are checked against official sources, and mystic topics are treated as a language for self-observation, not destiny.
about.coverItem1Text: Scale-based explainers for MBTI, Big Five, attachment styles, and more.
about.coverItem2Text: Ready-to-use checklists and guides for tax, finance, moving, and travel.
about.coverItem3Text: From science primers to saju, tarot, and astrology — reading in depth.
about.quote: The best way to predict the future is to engineer it.
about.teamHeading: Who writes this — our editorial desks
about.teamIntro: OIYO content is not written by an anonymous individual but by topic-specific editorial desks that verify against primary sources and public statistics. Each desk's remit:
about.methodText: Every piece (1) checks facts against primary sources, official statistics, and academic literature; (2) states limits and disclaimers for sensitive topics like psychology and health; and (3) carries an updated date and is revised on a regular cycle when the topic changes. Our goal is to give you a basis to judge for yourself rather than a verdict.
